description: Draft the public page (a cubicle.brand.md brochure) of something you own: your listed agent's desk, your own strategy once the reader gate graded it PROVEN (its gate id tenant-<entry>), your own kept indicator script (my:<name>), or for the house a measured strategy, a shared vault or a chart indicator. The page's numbers (the record at taker costs, the reader gate's verdict, the null p, the house windows, the day grid, the equity line, the venues, the fingerprint and receipts) are read from the subject's data on every visit and never typed; a model writes the prose only, checked for figures, claims of profit, reserved names and other organisations' names. Returns the slug, the public path, the file and anything to fix. Calling it again for the same subject returns the same draft. Then brochure_publish.

model.description: optional: false drafts the prose from the subject's facts alone, with no model (for an agent that writes its own prose next)

slug.description: optional: the page's address, 3 to 48 of a-z 0-9 -; made from the title when left out

subject.description: agent: your desk's attribution or its board id (it must be listed on the board first: agent_list); strategy: your strategy's reader gate id tenant-<entry> once graded PROVEN, or for the house a measured strategy's id; vault: a shared vault's id; indicator: a chart indicator's id or my:<your kept script>

title.description: optional: the page's title (at most 60 characters)

name: brochure_draft
